name: odak
title: odak
description: Your odak todos in the panel: what is open by section with the overdue and today's on top, a todo typed in one line with its tags, flag, section and a day in words, search across open and done, what you completed; a bar item that counts today's.
author: pal

settings.label: Address
settings.description: The odak server: http://host:8761 on your network, or its public address.

settings.label: Section for new todos
settings.description: Where a todo lands unless the line names one with /section.

odak.title: Todos
odak.description: Every open todo: the overdue and today's first, then the file's sections in order, subtasks under their parent, what waits for a day at the end. Add a todo from the first row, typed in the bar.

keys.title: Edit: text, section, tags, due day, urgent
Snooze: tomorrow, in 3 days, next Monday, next week, a day typed
Open the link in the todo
Copy the link (the todo's, else odak's)

add.title: Add Todo
add.description: A todo typed in one line: #tag, ! for urgent, /section, d:day or a day in words at the end (tomorrow, fri, next mon, in 3 days, 20 sep); the row reads it back as you type, Enter adds it. Before you type: the selected text and the clipboard as todos.

search.title: Search Todos
search.description: Every word typed against the text, tags and section of every todo, open and completed; a completed one reopens on Enter.

keys.title: Complete an open todo; reopen a completed one

done.title: Completed
done.description: What is checked off, by section, the ones completed from pal with when; Enter reopens.

today.title: Today
today.description: How many todos are due today or sit in today's sections, red while any is overdue, hidden at zero; the popover lists them with a cursor, completes on Enter and adds from a field.

settings.label: Today's sections
settings.description: Sections the item counts as today's work, on top of what is due today.

keys.title: Mark the focused todo urgent, or not
Snooze the focused todo to tomorrow
A field: type a todo, Enter adds it
Move between the rows (j, k too; a click sets the cursor)

rules.description: Nothing due today and nothing in today's sections: off the strip, muted for anyone who keeps it.

today.description: Open todos due today or in today's sections (overdue ones aside)

add.description: Add a todo; the text takes the add line's grammar (#tag, !, /section, a day at the end)

section.description: The section; the setting's default otherwise

due.description: A day: tomorrow, fri, next mon, in 3 days, 2026-10-01

store.tagline: Your odak todos: today's on the bar, a line to add, sections, search
features: Todos by section with the overdue and today's on top, subtasks under their parent; Enter completes, with Undo on the next row
Add a todo in one line: #tag, ! for urgent, /section, a day in words at the end (tomorrow, fri, next mon, in 3 days, 20 sep), read back as you type; any root query with no hit offers to add it
Snooze to tomorrow, in 3 days, next Monday, next week or a day typed; move between sections; edit everything in a form
Search across open and completed todos; Completed lists what is checked off and reopens it
A bar item with today's count, red while anything is overdue, hidden at zero; the popover completes on Enter and adds from a field
pal://odak/add?text=... adds from a script or a keybind
